resume_text:
MARIA LOPEZ, RN, BSN
Queens, NY | maria.lopez@example.com | (212) 555-0142

SUMMARY
Med-surg registered nurse with three years of acute-care experience on a high-acuity 32-bed unit. Charge nurse relief, preceptor for new graduates, member of the unit falls committee.

EXPERIENCE
Staff Nurse, Med-Surg (Nights) - Mount Sinai Queens, Astoria NY - Jul 2021 to present
- Care for 5 to 6 post-surgical and medical patients per shift: telemetry, IV therapy, wound care, insulin drips.
- Relief charge nurse two nights a week: bed assignments, staffing calls, rapid-response coordination.
- Precepted four new-graduate nurses through their 12-week orientation.
- Co-led the fall-prevention huddle rollout (hourly rounding, bed alarms, purposeful rounding script); unit falls fell from 9 to 4 per quarter.

Nurse Extern - NYC Health + Hospitals / Elmhurst - Jun 2020 to May 2021
- Vital signs, patient mobility, and discharge teaching under RN supervision on a 40-bed medical unit.

EDUCATION
Bachelor of Science in Nursing, Hunter-Bellevue School of Nursing, 2021

LICENSES AND CERTIFICATIONS
Registered Nurse, New York State, active
BLS and ACLS, American Heart Association

SKILLS
Epic, telemetry interpretation, IV insertion, wound vac management, Spanish (fluent)
